parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Design intent of Node 1: V-001 receives produced fluid and separates gas, oil and free water by density at nominal 60 psig/130 °F. Gas goes to fuel gas with excess to the burn pit, oil to the Heater–Treater and water to water treatment (SYS-02 to SYS-05). Guidewords were applied across all source-study elements (SYS-07, SYS-08), covering every inlet and outlet path rather than a single scenario. Highest priority goes to deviations that can defeat pressure containment or the liquid seal: high pressure (PV-101 failure, blocked gas outlet), loss of level with gas blow-by to the Heater–Treater or water treatment, high level with liquid carry-over to fuel gas and the burn pit, and the resulting fire/explosion. The source-supported human/procedural item (FWKO start-up without bypass opening) and operator line-up errors rank next (SYS-09). Corrosion, inlet surges, interface control, high and low temperature, low pressure, loss of inlet flow, reverse flow, erosion, shutdown and composition change are rated medium or lower. This is largely because design limits, E-001 role, fluid composition, non-return devices and instrument functions are not given. Existing safeguards are restricted to listed tags, with functions inferred only. Recommendations focus on verifying the relief basis, independent pressure/level trips, the design envelope, temperature monitoring, corrosion management and procedural controls.
